status: DIAGNOSTIC_RESULT -- no kappa, no gates, no EVAL, no new seeds
why_within_cell: Global AUC is inflated by between-cell base rates, which per-cell thresholds provably cannot exploit -- the oracle bound was o*_min = 0.3455 against a 0.10 ceiling.

arm_1_cell_only.input: cell identity (pole x regime x horizon) -> FIT base rate
arm_1_cell_only.note: within-cell AUC is 0.5 by construction; the score is constant inside a cell

arm_2_frozen_qpsi.input: Q_psi.encode(grid, vec, agent_mask, pole) -> h(256), FROZEN

arm_3_dedicated_encoder.input: IDENTICAL raw inputs to arm 2 (grid, vec, agent_mask, pole)
arm_3_dedicated_encoder.architecture: Conv(14->16,s2) ReLU Conv(16->16,s2) ReLU GAP -> MLP(62->16->1)

reading: Arm 3 reaches only 0.5198 within-cell, against arm 2's 0.5526, from identical inputs. Enlarging or unfreezing Q_psi is unlikely to help. The limit lies in observation sufficiency or in the target itself -- and per the frozen spec's ARM_4 note, those two remain ENTANGLED because no privileged-state collection exists.
arm_4_full_state_oracle: INFEASIBLE -- no privileged state was ever collected; see the frozen spec
does_not_alter: the CALIBRATION_FAILED verdicts of probe 1 or probe 2

THE_DECISIVE_OBSERVATION.finding: A ZERO-PARAMETER cell lookup achieves the HIGHEST global AUC of the three arms: 0.7194, against 0.7109 for the frozen Q_psi head and 0.6780 for the dedicated encoder. Knowing nothing but which regime a state belongs to beats both learned models.
THE_DECISIVE_OBSERVATION.what_it_means: The ~0.70 global AUC reported for probe 2 was ENTIRELY a regime base rate. It was never evidence of state-level resolvability prediction. Both learned representations sit at or below what a lookup table achieves, and within a cell all three are close to chance.
THE_DECISIVE_OBSERVATION.why_this_is_stronger_than_arm_3_merely_f: If arm 3 had simply underperformed arm 2, the reading would be 'this particular encoder was inadequate'. But arm 1 has no parameters and cannot overfit, cannot be under-trained, and encodes nothing except the cell. Being beaten by it means the learned models extracted no usable state-level signal at all -- not that they extracted it poorly.
THE_DECISIVE_OBSERVATION.arm_2_reproducibility_note: Arm 2 here scores 0.7109 global / 0.5526 within-cell against probe 2's 0.7041 / 0.5449. Different head seed, same conclusion -- the small gap is seed noise, which is itself a useful check that neither number is fragile.

CONSEQUENCE_FOR_THE_PROGRAMME.closed: Threshold machinery (o*_min = 0.3455 with oracle knowledge) and representation improvement (a zero-parameter baseline wins) are both exhausted as routes to state-level abstention under this target.
CONSEQUENCE_FOR_THE_PROGRAMME.still_entangled: Observation insufficiency versus genuine target difficulty. No privileged-state collection exists, so this audit cannot separate them -- recorded in the frozen spec before the result was known.
CONSEQUENCE_FOR_THE_PROGRAMME.what_survives_intact: Direction prediction. CALIB accuracy 0.7241 on resolvable states, above tau=0.70. The project can predict WHICH strategy is preferred where a preference exists. What it cannot do is recognise WHERE that is, at the level of individual states.
CONSEQUENCE_FOR_THE_PROGRAMME.not_established: That abstaining supervision is impossible in principle. Only that, under terminal win margin as the target and the policy observation as the input, state-level resolvability is not predictable at the frozen constraints.
